content: axum 0.8 removed #[async_trait] requirement for FromRequestParts; implement a custom SessionUser extractor via async fn from_request_parts(parts, state) that reads the Authorization: Bearer <token> header, hashes the token, looks it up in the sessions table via SQLx State<AppState>, and rejects with 401 if missing/expired. axum-auth crate offers AuthBearer as a ready-made header extractor but the session-hash-lookup logic must be hand-written.
